'**Action** - {r}, destroy this: Your hero gains +1{i} this turn.' + printed **Battleworn**. Guardian Equipment - Head (BravoHeroDeck).

BATTLEWORN NOT AUTHORED: it is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring it would be a defect.

ABILITY SHAPE copied from .drafts/fish_fingers.json ('Action - {r}, destroy this: ...' equipment) following shipped dyn/blacktek_whisperers.json. ability_type ACTIVATE matches the printed **Action** marker; play._add_hero_dsl_activations walks the head/chest/arms/legs slots among its activation sources, so head equipment activations are offered.

'{r}' is the card-level activation_cost field (1), DSL-authoritative per DSL_REFERENCE, and deliberately NOT also authored as a PAY_RESOURCES cost - that would double-charge.

'destroy this' sits before the colon, so it is the ability-level COST, not an effect (a cost can gate the activation): DESTROY_SELF, handler verified at cost_types.py:43-51 - can_pay always true while offered, pay calls canonical destroy() on the source card. Precedents: blacktek_whisperers, fish_fingers, glacial_horns drafts.

'+1{i} THIS TURN': GAIN asset INTELLECT amount 1 duration END_OF_TURN. Verified the GAIN handler (effect_types.py:4869-4926) reads asset/amount/duration; the INTELLECT branch increments player.intellect and, when duration is END_OF_TURN/THIS_TURN/TURN, queues dsl_pending_stat_restores for the end-phase cleanup. Without the duration param the gain would be permanent - a permanently larger draw-up every later turn - which is why 'this turn' is authored explicitly rather than left to the heuristic.
